snippet.title: Eel Game | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Eel Game throws you into a chaotic survival competition where every round brings something different. Face off against other players in a series of random mini-games, some skill based, some pure luck, all unforgiving.
The rules? Simple. Survive the games. Don't get eliminated.
The prize? Making it to the end... and maybe something more.

Wishlist on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3924400/Eel_Game/

Join the discord server: https://discord.gg/wrDmws6sA8
